name: Vehicle Color-24
description: Vehicle color recognition plays an important role in intelligent traffic management and criminal investigation assistance. However, the current vehicle color recognition research involves at most 13 types of colors and the recognition accuracy is low, which is difficult to meet practical applications. To this end, this paper has built a benchmark dataset (Vehicle Color-24) that includes 24 types of vehicle colors, including 10091 vehicle pictures taken from 100 hours of urban road surveillance videos. In addition, in order to solve the problem of long tail distribution in Vehicle Color-24 dataset and low recognition rate of existing methods, this paper proposes a Smooth Modulated Neural Network with Multi-layer Feature Representation (SMNN-MFR) is used for 24 types of vehicle color recognition. SMNN-MFR includes four parts: feature extraction, multi-scale feature fusion, suggestion frame generation and smooth modulation. The model is trained and verified on the Vehicle Color-24 benchma
reputation: A specialized vehicle attribute benchmark that is mainly used in the originating paper and related follow-up work rather than as a broadly adopted community standard.
notes: Long-tail 24-class recognition benchmark with relatively small dataset size and domain-specific surveillance imagery.
